reviews.author: Wayne
reviews.text: I recently had my 2020 corvette in for installation of AWE exhaust system. I took the car in the night before they closed and picked up after lunch. Work was exceptional. The system works great and more importantly the car did not need any programming from dealership. If I would not have came to Certified,I could have went with Borla or Corsa which both required reprogramming which cost time and money. Certified are genuinely interested and want to do the work right the first time. I highly recommend Certified and will have the Corvette serviced there. Thank you Wayne

reviews.author: Portia Wray
reviews.text: I am so glad I was referred & stumbled across Certified Automotive. They are very fairly priced, honest and a reliable auto shop for any and all repairs you may need. Check them out!! I have been very pleased with their overall service and they always figure it out and get it right!!

reviews.author: Barn Find
reviews.text: Let’s start off this review by saying this shop should not be working on cars. In fact I wouldn’t let them build a Lego set. I purchased a car that this “shop” put together and what a clown show it was. They love their JB Weld to fix parts rather than repairing or replacing them correctly. Who JB welds a transmission case to stop a leak??? These guys do!!!!! Who wraps up ground wires in duct tape and lets them hang under the intake manifold. Why does a mechanic shop even have duct tape???? I’m now repairing a handful of things that should have been addressed when the car was put together. Embarrassing to say the least. Be careful what you let this shop repair or work on because boy oh boy you will be very disappointed. Not sure how to reply on here but check the photo of the invoice. It’s your shop!

reviews.author: Kathie Brink
reviews.text: If your car needs repairs, this is the place to go to. They are honest, very fair pricing, and you get your car back fast. Never a problem. Called this morning, brought the car in and had it back by 3. I had a different problem with my car last year, and they told me to take it back to the dealer because it would be under warranty and wouldn't cost me anything. Who does that? Can't beat this place. I will always bring my car here for any work. Thank you

reviews.author: Tonya Girouard
reviews.text: These are the people to go to when you want the job DONE! I know it's an oxymoron to most to hear Honest Automotive Repair! but this place is that Unicorn Exception that I was looking for and needed! Another shop told me to buy transmission and get it to them and after having the transmission for almost 2 months they said they wouldn't be able to do it! Mary returned my call promptly, told me to get the vehicle and transmission to them, and jumped on fixing it quickly and reasonably! It was a big job and they communicated with me more in one week than the 2 months wasted at the other shop! I am very happy and grateful to have found them!

reviews.author: Susan Slone
reviews.text: I found this gem of a shop by word of mouth and I couldn’t be more pleased. Have brought in three separate vehicles for different servicing needs, and every time they have knocked it out of the park. Exceptional quality service by people you can trust. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kevin Hines
reviews.text: Had my lowering kit installed here and the experience was top-notch from start to finish. The team was professional, knowledgeable, and paid attention to every detail. The truck sits exactly how I wanted it, and the ride quality is dialed in perfectly. Everything was done cleanly and on time. You can tell they take pride in their work. Highly recommend this shop if you want it done right the first time. Thanks to Mary and Billy for their help. They have definitely earned all my future business.

reviews.author: Alan Johnson
reviews.text: I thought Certified’s reviews were not real. I came by way of referral. I needed a new starter. Billy went the extra mile getting a new part and then saving me time by taking out the old starter while waiting for the new one to arrive. He saved me an hour of time as I waited. He also saved me several hundred dollars by using him instead of a dealership. I am very impressed with his business and I have been getting cars serviced for over 60 years.

reviews.author: Todd Maffe
reviews.text: I took my car to Certified Automotive to have the front spoiler replaced, and they did an excellent job. The pricing was very fair, and everyone I interacted with was genuinely friendly and helpful. It’s a great group of people who clearly care about the quality of their work. If you’re looking for reliable, high-quality auto repair, this is definitely the place to take your vehicle. You won’t be disappointed.

reviews.author: Steven Makulowich
reviews.text: I was looking for a local shop to have an oil change done on my truck and to establish a relationship for future repairs. Certified Automotive did a great job on my trick. Very friendly service, prompt and professional as well as a fair price. I will certainly recommend them any time and know that If the need arises, they will be there for any repair needs. Keep up the good work!

reviews.author: Mohamed Bassiouny
reviews.text: All I can say is that I had an excellent experience with James and Mary. They professionally handled what I needed to do for my car and they made sure I was satisfied. They lowered my car, front and rear, and installed wheel spacers. James even offered to bring my car back for a free alignment after I replace my front tires, which I'm waiting to do. This was the first time I did any mods to any of my vehicles and will definitely use their services again for future mods. I highly recommend them and their business to anyone looking for a professional and a pleasant experience.

reviews.author: zsrule65 “Evil One” Rich
reviews.text: This is a custom shop that works on anything. The facility is brand new and so clean. Top notch everything especially the automotive technicians. I’ve been there a number of times for service on my Mustang GT350R. They’ve taken care of everything from oil changes, exhaust work, motor work and even put it on their in house chassis dyno. The dyno room has beautiful artwork on the walls and a huge TV to see the numbers for horsepower and torque. Nicest shop in Horry county. On same level as a new car dealership but without the dealer prices. Reasonable, knowledgeable and friendly. It’s hard to find people that actually care and they do care. James and Mary, the owners are always available to explain everything. They are the only shop in the entire county that I’ll ever use. Give them a chance to assist you and I promise you won’t be disappointed.

reviews.author: David Vail
reviews.text: Just had four tires installed, an alignment and adjustable rear camber arms installed on my Dodge charger. They did a great job for a great price.

reviews.text: These folks are the real deal. Not only did they help get our car diagnosed, they also have helped us in getting it to the certified dealership, pointing out where the Toyota dealership had failed to diagnose an issue, and has been calling the different repair centers to help fight for us. If Toyota can’t get their act together and pay for their failure, we’re going back to Certified no question. Thanks all! You are the best!

reviews.author: Moriah Lilly
reviews.text: We used Certified Auto in May 2023 to replace the air conditioning system in my 2011 Ford Escape. The service seemed fine, until we pulled out of the lot. Immediately, the vehicle sounded unusually loud. Before leaving the car with them, we had informed the shop owner that we would be out of town and not returning until Monday. During that time, our Escape was parked outside their fenced lot, and the catalytic converter was stolen. Certified Auto replaced it with a universal aftermarket catalytic converter that had to be cut and fitted to work. These parts typically last 70,000 to 100,000 miles (around 10 years), yet here we are less than two years later needing to replace both the catalytic converter and the exhaust manifold. Had they replaced the stolen part with the exact factory part instead of cutting corners with a universal substitute, we wouldn’t be facing these issues today. They claimed they were “helping us out,” but in reality, their decision has cost us significantly more in the long run. Don’t waste your time and money here. In addition: the owner of this shop felt the need to contact my father (a frequent customer) to “make things right” after the review. I don’t understand the reason when my contact information is on file. Sounds like small town gossip to me. Sloppy and unprofessional.

reviews.author: Brittany Zamora
reviews.text: We have taken multiple vehicles to Certified Automotive and consistently received satisfactory service. They demonstrate honesty and fairness in their estimates. Additionally, they refrain from installing unnecessary parts or making unsubstantiated diagnoses. They ensure you are leaving with a vehicle that has been repaired, rather than a bigger headache. They communicate and truly care about their customers. Thank you! You guys have been amazing.

reviews.author: Shawn
reviews.text: After reading reviews I called Certified Automotive cause my truck’s brakes were so bad, I was ready to slam an old lady in the rear. Within minutes I get a text back from Mary who says it’s her day off! Well my business must be pretty important for her to do that! She tells me Billy will give me a call since he’s holding down the fort at the shop. Billy rings me up within the half hour and lets me explain to him what’s wrong with my truck like I’m the mechanic. He offers several appointment times. I show up and guess who’s there? Day off Mary and Billy. They had the absolute gall to be polite, friendly, and explain the whole dang process without treating me like I’d never seen the inside of a Jiffy Lube. An hour after I drop her off, I get a call. I panic. I figure it’s bad news. Nope, just a breakdown of the issues, the cost, and this jaw-dropper: “You’ll have your truck back TODAY.” Couple hours later, phone rings again.I’m thinking’ she’s ready to roll. But nope, Billy tells me the breaks just aren’t feeling right to him or the other mechanics he had test them after replacing the pads. I’m thinking that’s what I tried to tell the dealership last year when they didn’t find an issue! He says the vacuum pump for the brake system is bad and needs replacing. My wallet cringes. I start gettin’ flashbacks to every mechanic horror story I’ve ever heard. But I trusted them and said go ahead. I offered them to take their time as I was not in a rush to get my truck back. A couple hours later he calls and say he’s got me ready. WHAT, SAME DAY? I was a bit shocked with the added work needed. I go to pick her up, and Billy himself checks me out. He took care of me! Treated me like a therapist addressing my anxiety from my over stimulated brain when I spend money. I get behind a school bus on highway 9 on the way home. That driver whips out that stop sign like he’s in the fast-draw finals at a duel. I slam on my brakes… Them brakes WORK. I mean WORK. I thought I was gonna die every time I stopped before. Now I stop so good I’m gonna give myself whiplash. Now I gotta relearn how to drive this truck! Thank you, Mary. Thank you, Billy. Thank you, mysterious vacuum pump. If y’all don’t take your vehicle to Certified Automotive, you clearly hate convenience, kindness, and not rear-ending people at red lights.

reviews.text: Had my steering rack replaced and some other parts fixed. Thought it was going to take a few days, but only took a day! Also they were quite a bit cheaper than the dealer too! Recent issue came up where a universal joint seized up and were able to diagnose it and temporarily fix it until I could get a part. Reasonable price to fix it and were very quick. Highly recommended if you have lowered cars or highly modified ones, they can work on all of it. Update 3/9/25: Been taking my car there for 5 years now... they are the only ones I'll let work on my cars. Great people and service!

reviews.author: Ginger Bryant
reviews.text: I was referred to this shop by Jim's Automotive in Ocean Isle Beach. I brought my truck in the same morning I called and they began to diagnose the problem before I left. One took it for a test drive and came back with smoke pouring out of the exhaust pipe. The next thing i knew, three of them were looking under the hood, discussing possible problems and options. Listening to them talk, it was very obvious that those guys love what they do! They ordered and replaced a valve cover at a very fair price. Billy called me twice to keep me informed of the progress as he knew I was without transportation. As a 70-year-old female, I cannot express how wonderful it was to find a trustworthy business that takes pride in its work and cares about its customers.

reviews.author: rscia50
reviews.text: Mary and James run a great shop! Every employee is fantastic and knowledgeable! Thanks for knocking out my front end alignment! I recommend you guys to everyone!

reviews.author: Fred Brown
reviews.text: Drove From Upstate NY. Had issues with our 16 Dodge Ram.. Not knowing any reputable repair shops we chose Certified because they were close to our Home in Longs. WELL let us tell you , not only were they extremely cordial upon first call, they got our truck right in . They then contacted us to discuss what the issue with the truck was. Knowing we were 1000 miles from our northern home, They treated us like were were the most important customer at that time. They repaired the truck ASAP and was MORE than fair with the charges . They have earned themselves an NEW CUSTOMER . What a welcome to our new community..THANK YOU CERTIFIED AUTOMOTIVE

reviews.author: Anthony Wrenn
reviews.text: Expert customer service!! Fantastic technicians! As long as I am here certified automotive will always be my go to for my vehicles! Mary was extremely helpful, she was able to give me a quote in no time and her communication was excellent through the process of the repairs I needed. Extremely impressed with her and the staff!

reviews.author: Will Jones
reviews.text: Can't say it loud enough...THESE GUYS ARE AWESOME. I brought these guys my 20 year old suv. I had been having issues for a while and a former mechanic that I used was no longer available. My friend Anthony suggested I take my truck here because they are who is currently doing work on two corvettes for the family. Once he said that I immediately thought they were going to charge me performance shop prices. But after receiving my estimate, I found that it was very competitive to others that I got. After dropping my car off. I was alerted that one of my issues had been misdiagnosed by my previous mechanic. That was no problem for these guys. They ended up doing more work for me than my estimate request, and still managed to save me money. Will not go anywhere else, you should give them a try.

reviews.author: Tim Wilgus
reviews.text: Such a wonderful business! My family and I were headed out of town and our alternator went out. Had the van towed to Certified Automotive and was so thankful I did. From the time we got there until the time we left we had excellent service. They fixed the alternator within a few hours and we were on our way! While we waited the kids were able to stay in the lobby and watch a movie on their TV. The lobby and shop are very clean and well kept. You can walk in and tell it is a well run business. I cannot thank Certified Automotive enough. Wether you are local or out of town, do not hesitate to take your car here. I wish I lived closer so they could be my regular mechanic, I would definitely take any car I had here!

reviews.author: Wayne
reviews.text: So glad to find such an amazing shop here in the Grand Strand area!! They are so professional, friendly and reasonable. I was very impressed with Certified Automotive!! They took a look at my car before giving me a price, promptly scheduled my work, performed the work, and charged me exactly what was quoted. No surprises, just good old fashion service. When I dropped my car off for service, my ride to work slept in so the owner of the shop offered to drive me to work!! Everything from the exterior of the building, to the reception, waiting room and shop itself was clean and on point. I could tell immediately this place took pride in their work!! They went above and beyond!! Highly recommended!!!

reviews.author: Stephanie Waller
reviews.text: Such a great family business! They truly care about their customers and stand behind their work, 110%! My husband is extremely picky and particular when it comes to anything involving his trucks and he swears by these guys! He will tell you that they did the best alignment he’s ever gotten and we now tell everyone to go to them! I also just recently went to have my Tahoe aligned and the owner would not let me leave in it until it was exactly right! 10/10 HIGHLY recommend!

reviews.author: Andre HERRIOTT
reviews.text: Quick, efficient and honest! I recently hit a deer damaging my suspension I had a traction control light come on took it to them and turns out all I needed was an alignment, truck now drives great and the traction control light is gone!

reviews.author: Shaun
reviews.text: I was having some grinding going on when I turned my vehicle. I happened to just stop in to see if I could set up an appointment to have them assess the situation. I pulled in at the right time, they immediately pulled my car in just to take a look and make sure there were no safety issues. They stated it looks good to drive and set me up for an appointment next morning. I just picked up my car and rides like a dream. James, Mary and Billy all took care of me. I will be sure I go to them for any and all of my auto needs. Thank you guys!!

reviews.author: Jennifer Mary
reviews.text: I wish I could give Certified a 100 star rating! I’m a first time, now lifetime customer. I left a voicemail message at midnight on Saturday for Mary about needing AC service , I thought I’d get a call back sometime on Monday, but she was already texting me on Sunday morning to ask some questions and schedule my appointment for first thing Monday. The crazy thing is they are located across the street from us on Route 9. A hidden gem. Spread the word, and call them for fast, reasonably priced and courteous service. My AC is cold, and the cost to do the work was the same as 3 years ago before we moved here! So so pleased and satisfied. Husband/wife owned and run shop with a great group of mechanics.

reviews.author: Dan
reviews.text: I broke down had my van towed to this place. They called and said they wanted 2000 for repairs. I questioned them at length. All it was was the air intake home came loose and it would not run. I paid them their diagnoses fee and have driven it for a week. Nothing wrong at all. These people and thieves RUN AWAY In response to their response they are lieing again. The only thing wrong with my van was the air intake hose came disconnected. this caused all these codes amd if they were honest they would have cleared the codes and NOT told me it needed 2000.00 in work. They never once said this is a worst case scenario! I questioned Billy the office manager at length bout all their quoted repairs and he never backed off any of them. I even called back after driving my van for about 120 miles with no check engine lights and not one thing wrong. Billy shouted me down and insisted they were right. I new this was suspicious and picked up the van paid their diagnosis fee which was totally false amd there is not one thing wrong with my van. They are liars amd tried to push off 2000.00 in unnecessary work on me. THAT is stealing ! MY GOOD OLE FAITHFULL VAN IS RUNNING GREAT

reviews.author: Nick Lawrence
reviews.text: Needed an alignment on my truck pretty badly. They were able to get me in within a couple of days and fixed it for me. For a tire rotation and an alignment, it was just a little over $100. I have a lifted truck with 35’s so I expected it to be way higher. Great prices for sure! Also, in the waiting area, they have games and things to do so you don’t have to sit there in silence lol. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Layla Wray
reviews.text: I could not have asked for a better experience with this shop!! Mary is who I spoke to throughout the entire process & she is absolutely wonderful. All of the staff that I came into contact with & spoke to were just as great. Communication & customer service was outstanding, very very honest shop. Dropped my Jeep off on a Friday afternoon & had it back the following Tuesday, which is impressive for engine work! They really took such good care of me & my vehicle!! I’m so thankful to have found these guys.

reviews.author: Jim White
reviews.text: I had an odd electrical issue that didn't have a straightforward cause. Mary listened to the various symptoms intently, asked the lots technical questions, put a mechanic on it right away and consulted with a few others to set a course of action. As a mechanical engineer, i was very impressed. I've never been in an auto shop where my observations were taken seriously, and where I see a team of people attack the issue. I was actually included as part of the team. They showed me what they were doing, other potential issues, and explained things along the way. I'm sure most people wouldn't care for the level of technical engagement I received, but it was above and beyond what I'd ever expect or have ever received. The depth of technical engagement of everyone here is unlike the typical auto shop. These folks are way more than auto mechanics. They love their work, get into their work, and work together. Impressive!

reviews.author: Anthony Abajian
reviews.text: My car had a misfire I had been dealing with for a month. James had it figured out in a few days time span. Not many people I trust with my car but Certified is one of them. Take your vehicle here.

reviews.author: Dustin Hall
reviews.text: Can’t say enough about James and his team. They accepted the challenge of engine swapping a rare, over-engineered Cadillac ATS-V re-aligned suspension and cleaned up some other odds and ends to make this car better than it was brand new! Their attention detail, willingness to ensure everything is perfect and integrity is value you won’t find in most shops. Thank you all and if anybody has any doubt in who to trust to get the job done, call Certified!

reviews.author: Michael Kouns
reviews.text: James and his crew are amazing technicians and they couldn’t possibly be an kinder or more friendly. If you love your car this is the place to take it to get serviced.

reviews.author: Nicholas Lindemann
reviews.text: As the owners of a car detailing company we take pride in our vehicles, we wouldn’t trust anyone else to service our personal vehicles than Certified! The staff is amazing and so kind, always extremely welcoming… they fixed the A/C in my truck that hadn’t worked in 10+ years at an extremely affordable cost and in only a few hours, they even waved the diagnostic fee because we choose them to service my truck! We found out about certified through local friends that highly recommended them, Certified Automotive is the best in Myrtle Beach!!

reviews.author: Taylor
reviews.text: Mary went above and beyond! I messaged Mary to get a quote and she responded while on vacation. We had my Mothers car towed there and they did a phenomenal job. They did all 4 breaks and rotors and 1 caliper replacement. The customer service is hands down the best around and they make you feel like family. Would highly recommend to anyone who needs any work done. This was our first time using them and we will definitely be back for any of our cars needs.

reviews.author: Laurie Zacher
reviews.text: I called certified to ask if they worked on BMWs? James, the owner said not typically if it’s a major issue. I mentioned that the check engine light had appeared after my “tighten gas cap appeared.” He said to bring it in , and he’ll hook up a machine, and try to clear out the error code. Well… He did!! I think I was there for a good 15 minutes I said OK how much do I owe you , and he said nothing don’t worry about it!!!!! I was already a loyal customer with both my vehicles. I have become a long time, loyal customer now! Thanks James!!!

reviews.author: Dave Dijan
reviews.text: Thanks James for looking out for me I really appreciate it u went above and beyond u really stand behind your work and I would highly recommend anyone I know to his shop.

reviews.author: Laura King
reviews.text: I was on my way home to NC and had a 4 hour drive. I got in a wreck and busted my radiator. The staff and owners were amazing! They not only replaced my radiator same day so that I could make it back home for work but they charged me way less then the other shops around the area were gonna charge me and it would have taken the other shops multiple days. They were all very pleasant and so happy to help. I really liked how every employee I saw there really seemed to enjoy their job and looked happy….I think that says a lot about the owners. I couldn’t give this place enough praise! I will recommend them to everyone I know in this area and Kay will definitely use them again myself when I’m in the area!!

reviews.author: david scher
reviews.text: I have known James since he first relocated to South Carolina. His knowledge in Automotive Mechanics is beyond impressive. I am now a Service Manager for a large used car lot. I have used James to service hundreds of our vehicles and can’t say enough good about his shop and staff. If you need an honest thorough mechanic, check them out. Mary is always so helpful even when I can be a pain! Mary and James are great business owners and are beyond awesome! Thank you guys for everything!!

reviews.author: Izak Venuti
reviews.text: Buy for the most respectful professional establishment in the car business I have ever been to I searched for a very year to get my AC fixed. It took that Gentlemen and his lovely wife. Half hour to figure it out and only a 1/2 hour to fix it. I would recommend anybody to go to this shop. Hands down by far the best I've ever been to. Thanks again for everything you guys have done

reviews.author: tompass2
reviews.text: I want to thank Certified Auto for diagnosing and repairing an issue I was having with my brakes. I take seriously the maintenance of my cars and was fortunate to find this professionally managed shop. Everything was fully explained, appointment made, and work was done to my complete satisfaction on time and at a fair price. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Thomas Brown
reviews.text: I was sent their way after a quote from a large automotive chain to get a second opinion. Not only did they fix the problem but for almost 50% less!! I have since sent all my automotive needs to James and his team. They’re honest and straightforward, they will consult you with options you can afford! I send and will continue to send my friends and anyone who has automotive needs their way…100% A blessing to have found this auto motive repair team!

reviews.author: Steven Robertson
reviews.text: Amazing place people knowledgeable friendly And honest took my car there to have an engine installed. Had called around to several yards to inquire about a engine. What I got was a national data base of people that had engines for sale. The only caveat was I wouldn't have any way of knowing what I was getting. I was inundated by callers trying to sell me a engine. So as a last resort I called Mary and James of certified Automotive. I had the surprise of a lifetime Mary had a engine for my car. All ready on hand and at a great price. Actually the price so good I had enough to get CV Axles for the car. I've driven the car home and it runs great. Thank Certified Automotive now I can truly say I have a new car at a used car price.

reviews.author: Sabrina Hilliard
reviews.text: It's been years since I have been comfortable with anyone working on my car. I found this place and I am never looking anywhere else again. What wonderful service, excellent pricing, and they have been amazing to work with. I highly recommend seeking them out for all your vehicle repair needs.

reviews.author: Susan Zebley
reviews.text: We dropped off out daughters car to get a evaluation of what the car needed.. It had not been serviced in a long time. I got a call from Billy who explained what needed to be done right away and other things that could wait awhile until she could afford to repair them..Billy kept me posted of how things were going and what to expect..I could't have asked for more. Excellent customer service. I highly recomend Certified Automotive ! Next time we need something that's the first place we will go..

reviews.author: JEREMY SMITH
reviews.text: Great shop! Honest and great pricing. The knowledge the team members has is amazing. Anything from basic maintenance to new engines with huge turbos. Even a dyno!! literally have it all under one roof. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: T cocco
reviews.text: Great, shop and honest! I made an appointment and they were right on time. Mary was very accommodating and pleasant she responded very quickly to my request. Will definitely return for service!!

reviews.author: Tiffany Vereen
reviews.text: Always quick and reliable, If I could I would give them more stars!!!!! Mary and team thank you guys for everything!!

reviews.author: Barbara Nelson
reviews.text: We found Certified Automotive where I went to a car show at this business. Called for an appointment last week as our 67 Corvette was in need of an oil and filter change.Also rear brake lites were not working. They changed the oil and filter and also found the problem with the brake lites. This is a great company.

reviews.author: Philip Ross
reviews.text: Fast and friendly service at a fair price. Diagnosed and repaired the problem with my Jeep and I was quickly back on the road. I will definitely be using them for my future automotive repairs.

reviews.author: Kristine Kaliebe
reviews.text: What a breath of fresh air! Can't say how much I appreciate honesty when it comes to car repair! I drove 5 + hours to get ANY car work done here. It's ALWAYS WORTH IT! SAVES ME SO MUCH MONEY TO HAVE HONEST REPAIR WORK!

reviews.author: Jackie Johnson
reviews.text: Had some work done on my Miata. Great customer service, great technicians, and overall wouldn’t take my cars anywhere else in the area.

reviews.author: Charlee LaCourse
reviews.text: They have been upfront and honest throughout the entire process. Mary has been awesome at keeping me in the loop and I have full confidence in their direction. I'm glad my brother recommended me to Certified Automotive as I will be doing the same :)

reviews.author: Shelby Boogie
reviews.text: Mary and James have a super professional shop! Went in Monday for a tire rotation and re balance. Was in and out in no time at all. They keep the prices fair and have an awesome crew. Thank you guys again!

reviews.author: Rose Keeler
reviews.text: We have had James do repair and maintenance work on two vehicles. He is knowledgeable, friendly and reasonable. He gets the work done quickly and reliably.

reviews.author: Arnette Vereen
reviews.text: Mary and James have been crucial to keeping our service vehicles on the road, along with all personal vehicles. Will never take our trucks, cars and vans anywhere else. The best in town!

reviews.author: Paul Lavazza
reviews.text: We bring multiple cars and for service and they are great to work with and know by their trade. Wouldn’t go anywhere else. Thank you for great service!!

reviews.author: Amy Kowalski
reviews.text: Fantastic customer service. I had a major component swtchedi out on my car at a dealership. Was uneasy about the fix , they had someone drive my car and put my mind at ease. I will be going to them for all my car needs

reviews.author: Derek Craig
reviews.text: I have been using Certified Automotive since they have opened. I have known the owner for close to 20 years, He is very knowledgeable and honest. You will not regret taking your vehicle to them for whatever your needs are.

reviews.author: Rick
reviews.text: 1st timer. Friendly staff. I got an oil change on a 2011 Toyota Highlander - $85! 20 minutes. (Also included an all-system check.)

reviews.author: Brad Byron
reviews.text: Certified Automotive in Longs South Carolina on Route 9 is an absolutely fabulous place to get any type of auto repair or maintenance done. It's done right the first time. I will continue to refer others to Certified.

reviews.author: Shin Gojira
reviews.text: Recently had a brake service, their customer service was stellar. The owners James and Mary treated me like a part of their family. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for an honest business.

reviews.author: Jimbo Scrim
reviews.text: Absolutely phenomenal. Billy was amazing. Helped me when i need it. Everyone is extremely friendly and a very family friendly environment. Will definitely revisit when i come back to SC!

reviews.author: Aydin Carr
reviews.text: Best Shop around, very efficient and great people. Recommend to anyone looking for a trustworthy shop

reviews.author: Meg Epps
reviews.text: Fixed my starter and was super fast and also took the time to check on the rest of the car, when they didn’t have to! will be returning from now on

reviews.author: Elaine DiDio
reviews.text: Our experiences with the folks & owners at this shop have been positive. Friendly and professional, they are quick to respond and offer great service at a reasonable price.

reviews.author: TWANK TWANK
reviews.text: Custom one-off exhaust was completed in a timely manner and to expectations. Highly recommended. Thank you Certified Automotive!

reviews.author: Brandi White
reviews.text: Very good job on my 99 Honda - quick responses by text and phone. Very friendly and easy to work with.

reviews.author: David Cook
reviews.text: Very nice facility with friendly staff. Knowledgeable in every facet of the industry. I will be forwarding business to this location when asked which shop to get repairs done at. Highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: Cameron Bosworth
reviews.text: James dyno'd my dirt track race car and went above and beyond what I asked for. Highly recommended for tuning and automotive repair.

reviews.author: Travis Mcshane
reviews.text: Great place for any type of automotive service preformed. Great people to do business with. I'll go back for any type of automotive repair I have.

reviews.author: Michael Green
reviews.text: Above and beyond the best mechanic shop around. Can’t thank them enough for what they did for me . Highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Betsy Starch
reviews.text: Mary and James are Awesome! They run the most amazing, honest, caring business! I always recommend them!!!

reviews.author: Richard Ramos
reviews.text: Talk to Mary or James for your automotive needs. Should of named it 5 star automotive. Thanks for the tune on Eddie.

reviews.author: William Palmer
reviews.text: These guys were great very professional. In and out could not have asked for a better experience !!!
